posts.title: The art of making LLMs faster: Inference Optimization
posts.excerpt: Training a large language model gets the headlines, but training happens once. Inference, i.e., the process of actually answering a prompt happens billions of times a day, and it's where most of the real engineering effort is.

posts.title: Meet the LPU
posts.excerpt: Everyone talks about bigger models and better prompts. But the real bottleneck in AI today is latency. Every LLM response is generated one token at a time. That's where traditional hardware starts to struggle.

posts.title: RNNs walked so BERT and GPT could talk
posts.excerpt: I worked on a Natural Language Processing (NLP) project last Spring that led me to utilize BERT, and here's a deep-dive into everything I learnt along the way!
